definitions.z_euclidean: Common I, separate Z_t/C_t, Euclidean projection. Same initialization, source observations, L-step and dual schedule as both other Z variants; no sparsity penalty.
definitions.z_hessian: Only replace projection by full empirical Hessian plus Euclidean proximal term. Omit the linear task-gradient term. Local conditional assignment/C sweeps; no exact multidimensional DP claim.
definitions.z_taylor: Same full metric as z_hessian, add the task gradient at Z+U. For squared loss this projector minimizes actual source support+query loss plus proximity. Its temporary C sees these source training observations; all evaluation C are reset and fit on support only.
definitions.meta_stop: Warm-start the pilot-selected z_euclidean I. Shared signed-one-hot/zero A, hard forward, support-fitted C, query gradient with C response stopped. Six Adam rates, four latent jitters, no per-entry query enumeration.
definitions.meta_full: Exactly meta_stop except differentiate through the damped exact support-fit C. The hard projection uses a surrogate straight-through backward, not an exact discrete gradient.
definitions.query_edits: Existing exact one-entry source-query refinement, at most64 accepted changes, initialized with the same z_euclidean I. Reference only, no HPO.

selection.checkpoint: For each configuration, source-query chooses restart and improving source proposals; independent coefficient validation selects checkpoint. Exact unregularized support adaptation for all reported checkpoint scores.
selection.hpo: Mean pilot validation over two new geometries and two seeds. First freeze projection settings, then meta pilots start their selected z_euclidean states. Meta settings frozen before new confirmation geometry preparation.
selection.64_control: Uses the same selected settings as8-task primary; no64-task HPO. The first8 functions are a subset of64. Same independent validation tasks within family.
selection.truth: Only W shape and K enter search. Teacher mask, groups, active count and permutations are closed until every confirmation model is frozen.
selection.transfer: 100 new independent coefficient functions per new family, fresh exact support fit C, no source numeric state. Six independent geometries; seeds not counted as extra geometries.
selection.diagnostic: Identical candidate pool from saved Z checkpoints and a fixed random set of one-entry perturbations. Compare Euclidean/refitted-C, empirical prediction metric, Taylor and actual post-support-fit query loss. Taylor equality is an algebraic guard, not evidence of a novel predictor.
selection.checks: No software tests. One scientific gradient directional audit, exact Taylor identity guard, lint and figure inspection.
